entries.scenePrompt: A single local size edit. DO NOT MOVE the small cube again. DO NOT CHANGE any line or cell of the large blue assembly. Uniformly shrink ONLY the small blue cube beside its closest lower corner by FIFTEEN PERCENT, including all three faces and its shadow. Its current upright edges are visibly longer than one adjoining bottom-row cell; after the reduction they must be the SAME HEIGHT as that cell. Keep the small cube's bottom resting at its current ground contact, so the shorter top aligns with the neighboring bottom-row top edge. Match the face slopes with the adjacent cell. Preserve the large ten-by-ten-by-ten grid, material, composition and background. No ruler, text, symbols, labels, digits or arrows.
